blocks.text: findings: one entry per finding, each with a severity and a short note.
signed_at: when the inspector signed, set on the device. Not when the record arrives anywhere.
schema_version (new): which version of this record format the inspection was made with, so records from an older tablet still read correctly after a change.
The inspector signs on the device at the moment of signing, online or not. signed_at is stamped right then.
The PDF prints the signature and the time signed.
Each PDF carries a short check code, so an auditor can confirm the file hasn't changed since it was signed.
A signed inspection is never edited. A correction is a new inspection that points to the old one.
